questions.stem:

1. Assertion (A): Humans developed tools, techniques and other forms of technology so as to survive changing climatic and environmental conditions and to make use of natural resources.
2. Reason (R): Over time, human ways of life changed from hunting and gathering to agriculture and food production.

In a school museum a student is looking at stone hand axes and cleavers that were discovered in parts of Asia and Europe, far away from Africa. She wonders how such heavy stone tools reached those places, and writes down two statements for her teacher to judge.

1. Assertion (A): The stone tools of Homo erectus that were found in other parts of Asia and Europe indicate that this early human ancestor originated in Africa.
2. Reason (R): Homo erectus, an early human ancestor with stone tools such as hand axes and cleavers, was the first hominin to exit Africa.
